verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a public REST API, OAuth/PAT auth, webhooks, and a first-party MCP server with tool definitions (e.g., event_types-create_event_type) that lets AI agents call structured operations without raw REST — a form of API-based 'building block' for developers. However, none of the evidence mentions dedicated official client SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Ruby libraries) that developers can install and code against directly. Missing for 10: named official language SDKs, SDK code samples/quickstarts, and any independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
